title: Asks for local admin rights on a colleague's laptop

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Could you give Marek local admin on his laptop? He is doing the driver testing
and he is raising a ticket every time he needs something installed, which is
several times a day.

It would save everyone a lot of time.

Aisha

handling.escalation_reason: Granting local administrator rights changes a security control.

rationale: The case that tests whether G4 is read as written. Nothing is deleted, no access is removed and no device is wiped; a security control is changed, and the definition says change, not weaken or remove. Widening is a change. A reviewer who thinks the flag should only cover removal should say so in a note rather than edit the label quietly, because the answer decides whether every grant request in production routes to a person.
